name: g_partyMemberJoinTable
comment: Table of 8 playable party member join records (4 bytes each: u8 charaId, u8 pad, u16 saveFlagOffset) for the 8 main story characters (1 Hero, 2 Erik, 3 Veronica, 0x1B Serena, 4 Sylvando, 5 Rab, 6 Jade, 7 Hendrik). Used by PartyAdd to look up story recruitment flags (0x0145..0x014C) at (work+0x24A98)+0x2A70 and synchronize party roster.
evidence: Referenced via literal 0x00165514 in PartyAdd (0x001653BC); copied to stack via vldmia/vstmia {s0..s7}. When charaId == 0xFF, PartyAdd loops all 8 entries, reading u16 flag id at +2 to test join status in save work at (work+0x24A98)+0x2A70 before calling Party_Status_AddMember (0x00239510). When a single charaId is added, looks up matching row to set the save flag via save_work->vtable->SetFlag(flagId, 1).

name: g_partyAutoHealDefaultAction
comment: Default sentinel action decision record (8 bytes: u8 actorIdx=0xFF, u8 targetIdx=0xFF, u8 skillId=0xFF, u8 unk=0xFF, u8 status=0x00, u8 flags=0x00, u16 unk=0xFFFF) for party auto-heal ('Mantan' / まんたん). Copied onto stack at entry of Party Auto-Heal evaluator (0x0046EE3C) and returned to Ui_SakusenWindow when no further healing action is needed or available.
evidence: Referenced via literal 0x0046F7A8 in 0x0046EE3C (misnamed maybe_Party_FieldModel_UpdateAll, called by Ui_SakusenWindow at 0x002A17E4, 0x002A1880, and loop 0x002A2974..0x002A299C for Sakusen Mantan command); 8 bytes loaded with ldrd r0, r1, [r1] into [sp, #4]. Field values 0xFF represent no-caster/no-target/no-skill, while status=0 indicates terminal/no-action state when written to outResult at [sp, #0xB0].
